package syscall

import "unsafe"

type GomadPointerObservation struct {
	Entry [2]uintptr
	After [3]uintptr
	Calls int
}

var gomadPointerObservation GomadPointerObservation
var gomadPointerActive, gomadPointerNoGrowth bool

func GomadPointerReset(active, noGrowth bool) {
	gomadPointerObservation = GomadPointerObservation{}
	gomadPointerActive, gomadPointerNoGrowth = active, noGrowth
}

func GomadPointerSnapshot() GomadPointerObservation { return gomadPointerObservation }

//go:noinline
func gomadPointerGrowWritev(p *Iovec, depth int) {
	if !gomadPointerActive {
		return
	}
	gomadPointerObservation.Calls++
	gomadPointerObservation.Entry[0] = uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p))
	if gomadPointerNoGrowth {
		vectors := unsafe.Slice(p, 2)
		gomadPointerObservation.After = [3]uintptr{uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(vectors[0].Base)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(vectors[1].Base))}
		return
	}
	gomadPointerObservation.After = gomadPointerRecurseWritev(p, depth)
}

//go:noinline
func gomadPointerRecurseWritev(p *Iovec, depth int) [3]uintptr {
	var frame [128]uint64
	for i := range frame {
		frame[i] = uint64(depth + i)
	}
	var after [3]uintptr
	if depth == 0 {
		vectors := unsafe.Slice(p, 2)
		after = [3]uintptr{uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(vectors[0].Base)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(vectors[1].Base))}
	} else {
		after = gomadPointerRecurseWritev(p, depth-1)
	}
	if frame[depth] != uint64(depth*2) {
		panic("writev stack frame corrupted")
	}
	return after
}

//go:noinline
func gomadPointerGrowPair(raw *RawSockaddrAny, length *_Socklen, depth int) {
	if !gomadPointerActive {
		return
	}
	gomadPointerObservation.Calls++
	gomadPointerObservation.Entry = [2]uintptr{uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(raw)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length))}
	if gomadPointerNoGrowth {
		gomadPointerObservation.After = [3]uintptr{uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(raw)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length))}
		return
	}
	gomadPointerObservation.After = gomadPointerRecursePair(raw, length, depth)
}

//go:noinline
func gomadPointerRecursePair(raw *RawSockaddrAny, length *_Socklen, depth int) [3]uintptr {
	var frame [128]uint64
	for i := range frame {
		frame[i] = uint64(depth + i)
	}
	var after [3]uintptr
	if depth == 0 {
		after = [3]uintptr{uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(raw)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length))}
	} else {
		after = gomadPointerRecursePair(raw, length, depth-1)
	}
	if frame[depth] != uint64(depth*2) {
		panic("sockaddr stack frame corrupted")
	}
	return after
}

//go:noinline
func gomadPointerGrowOption(p unsafe.Pointer, length *_Socklen, depth int) {
	if !gomadPointerActive {
		return
	}
	gomadPointerObservation.Calls++
	gomadPointerObservation.Entry = [2]uintptr{uintptr(p), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length))}
	if gomadPointerNoGrowth {
		gomadPointerObservation.After = [3]uintptr{uintptr(p), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length))}
		return
	}
	gomadPointerObservation.After = gomadPointerRecurseOption(p, length, depth)
}

//go:noinline
func gomadPointerRecurseOption(p unsafe.Pointer, length *_Socklen, depth int) [3]uintptr {
	var frame [128]uint64
	for i := range frame {
		frame[i] = uint64(depth + i)
	}
	var after [3]uintptr
	if depth == 0 {
		after = [3]uintptr{uintptr(p), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length))}
	} else {
		after = gomadPointerRecurseOption(p, length, depth-1)
	}
	if frame[depth] != uint64(depth*2) {
		panic("socket option stack frame corrupted")
	}
	return after
}
